en: Where... is this?
Every clock says 23:59. None of them are moving.
Time doesn't stop. It waits. Where did I hear that?
A pocket watch. Cracked glass. Still warm, like someone just put it down.
23:59. The seconds digit flickers, but it never turns over.
Easy. Don't hang up. You're in Elysium-09, under the old transit line.
The station is under a containment lock. Every door you've seen was sealed at 23:59.
That watch still remembers how things were. Use it. Time doesn't stop. It waits.
Who is this? How do you know about the watch?
Later. Restore auxiliary power at Signal Control. The street exit opens from there.
This line won't hold much longer. Keep moving.
Don't stare at it too long. An echo only does what you already chose to do.
That was me. A minute ago. And it's still standing there.
Two people on this bench. One of them sits the way I do.
Mira. I know that voice. Why do I know that voice?
Power's back. Good. Now go straight to the street exit.
There's a dispatch terminal in the Atrium. Leave it alone. It won't help you.
I walked north. I came out of the west arch. The building is lying to me.
It knows my hand.
Level-0 clearance. Someone sealed this station from here. And it opened for my hand.
Did I do this?
The same minute, over and over. Probably a clock fault. Probably.
The rain isn't falling. It's hanging in the air, waiting.
You are late.
Again.
Elias
Mira
VOICE
Someone else passed through the West Turnstile seconds before the station froze at 23:59.
An evacuation was ordered at 23:54. Five minutes later, every clock stopped.
A voice on the call box knows the station, the lock, and the watch. It won't say who it is.
Days before the lock, technicians logged "chronometric backflow". The directors told them to ignore it.
Two traces on the lounge bench: a woman, and a man who stands like me.
Mira asked me not to come back for her if the stabilization failed.
The voice on the intercom warned me away from the Atrium dispatch logs. What is it hiding?
The ELYSIUM field indexes doorways. When time froze, some stopped leading where they should.
The containment lock was executed from the Atrium terminal at Level-0. The terminal knew my hand. Did I do this?
The terminal log repeats one line: 23:59:00, the same biometric match. A fault?
Memory: The Lounge Bench
Her hand on my sleeve. The departure board flickering. She was asking me for something, and I said no.
The turnstile rotor is crushed shut. Force won't move it.
Only Rewind can restore this fractured mechanism.
Solid station concrete. No temporal fracture here.
The gear is frozen solid. Unfreeze it before rewinding the shutter.
The stripped gear has no memory to rewind. Try the shutter.
Too heavy to lift by hand.
The shutter is too heavy to freeze. Target the counterweight gear.
Locked by the floor pressure switch on the south deck.
Chrono-shielded security gate. It can't be frozen or rewound.
Chrono-shielded plate. It only responds to weight.
Breaker is already engaged.
Insulated high-voltage switch. The watch can't affect it.
The power bus is dead. Stabilize the central capacitor first.
Bulkhead sealed. Engage both breakers at once to restore power.
The north arch is routed to the Atrium. The West Loop can't re-engage.
Route conflict on the north arch. Uncouple the West Loop first.
Spatial relays sit outside local time. Switch them by hand.
